deliverable: Original full-film script ke continuous opening 20 seconds; separate summary/trailer nahi
opening_scope: Orcas shikaar kar rahi hain... se sequential narration; actual audio timing determines endpoint

creative_north_star.story: Viewer ko opposite-direction approach ka puzzle action se samajh aaye, claims ya graphics se manipulate na ho
creative_north_star.art: Intentional composition, readable animal weight and depth; pretty reference ko working rig proof na samjho
creative_north_star.editing: Designed visual progression and choreography; high-end editing independent department hai, shots jodna nahi
creative_north_star.motion_design: Custom explanatory transformation only when needed; kinetic typography optional, not compulsory decoration
creative_north_star.compositing: Unified scene lighting, depth, material response and graphic integration
creative_north_star.sound: Authored perspective, rhythm, space and silence; actual listening review, not loudness-only approval
creative_north_star.viewer_respect: Curiosity and clarity, not nonstop stimulation or fake scientific certainty

rejected_patterns: Persistent chapter headings, lower-left captions, progress rail, diet info cards from rejected cut
Random whooshes, bubbles, generic music used without actual listening-compatible comparison
Slideshow, repeated stills, pan/zoom as animal motion
Over-rendering a known weak asset or hiding defects in darkness
evidence_rules: Distinguish text_read, still_viewed, video_viewed and audio_listened
Never mark audiovisual review from transcript, screenshots or waveform alone
Claim-source ledger, asset-level rights and changes recorded
4-6 second integrated internal proof before full render
